summary: ci-local-test lets the stopped run make progress between looks, so the test catches it inside its /proc listing instead of starving it until the deadline, recognises its own worker in the middle of the worker's exec, and a failing run of that test no longer leaves its lane stopped.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no stored data is read or written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: scripts/ci-local is unchanged; only its test changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the commits; the test then fails on a loaded host again.
